scope.definition: Currently compiled event IDs; supporting old cards are context.

summary: Rejected: the school and cake sequences assume unchosen visits/tastings, and the domino wager treats a skill-sensitive game as pure chance. All nine cards were read with shop/place canon.

issues.problem: The second setup says the children have talked of nothing else since last time and asks the player to come back. The third brings children in paper wizard hats. A player who always bought the schoolmistress tea never visited her class, so the second showing invents the visit whose payoff it celebrates.
issues.fix: Gate the remembered classroom visit on actually choosing it, or make each request the schoolmistress’s continuing invitation.

issues.problem: On later showings Mabel treats the player as the brave experimental-cake tester and serves it unasked even when every earlier choice was Stick with your usual. Showing the card does not earn the trial reputation.
issues.fix: Let Mabel remember the actual tasting choice, or retain her recurring attempt to recruit a reluctant tester without claiming an earned reputation.

issues.problem: Playing the regulars’ domino game is a bare chance even roll. Unlike the knucklebones card, this is a game where reading the board, remembering played tiles and opponents’ habits plausibly matter; the player’s skills cannot affect it.
issues.fix: Use a suitably pitched skill-sensitive wager with luck swing, preserving the pot and loss as outcomes.
